cc:Work.dc:title: Supervised cross-farm comparison
cc:Work.dc:description: Capacity-normalized point RMSE and rolling interval coverage for all six methods. Points show seed means; bars show seed ranges. HistGBR uses seed 0. The dashed line is nominal 0.95 coverage.
